races.paceDynamic: Until Dawn will lead from the outset with no genuine pace pressure, as Fuji Mountain and I'm Next are more prominent types than confirmed early leaders. This creates a sustainable gallop that allows Until Dawn to dictate terms through steady fractions before the sprint home. The seven hold-up horses will be bunched behind the modest early pace, setting up a cavalry charge in the final two furlongs. This tactical setup strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will plague the large hold-up contingent.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Kicks
scenarios.trigger: If Until Dawn gets an easy lead and finds extra gear when challenged
scenarios.body: The 4yo gets first run on his rivals from the front and his 7lb weight advantage helps him sustain the effort when the closers come hunting. The prominent racers get best of the rest positions behind the winner.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If I'm Next and Fuji Mountain track the leader perfectly and time their challenges
scenarios.body: Both get ideal trips behind the uncontested leader and have the pace-advantage over the hold-up brigade who face a wall of horses. Form horses with better ratings capitalize on superior positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic-Free Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the better hold-up horses gets a dream run through when others are stopped
scenarios.body: A horse like Trilby or Novello Lad finds racing room at the crucial moment while their hold-up rivals are shuffling for gaps. The winner benefits from others' misfortune rather than superior tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Until Dawn folds tamely leaving prominent pair to fight it out
scenarios.body: The long-absent leader proves ring-rusty over this sharp track and the two prominent runners inherit perfect positions. They dominate the finish as the hold-up horses never get competitive.

watchPoints.text: Until Dawn breaks poorly from stall and loses his tactical advantage as the only front-runner
Traffic develops into chaos in final furlong as seven hold-up horses hunt for racing room simultaneously
I'm Next and Fuji Mountain track too close to Until Dawn early and compromise their finishing kicks
The pace proves faster than expected if Fuji Mountain or I'm Next press Until Dawn from flag-fall
Novello Lad shows ring-rustiness early after 199-day absence despite his excellent historical course form

races.paceDynamic: Milteye will likely set the early pace from a prominent position, with A War Eagle, Lord Roxby, Nyman, Yaajooz, Tropez Power and Frostmagic all likely to race handy in the early stages. This creates a potentially strong pace with multiple prominent runners ensuring no dawdling, particularly as Milteye has shown front-running tendencies recently. The substantial group of hold-up horses including Capital Guarantee, Highfield Viking, Surprised and Priapos will be relying on a truly-run race to get their optimal late kick. This pace setup clearly favours prominent runners who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the early pace battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Strong Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners engage early and maintain a solid gallop throughout
scenarios.body: Milteye sets a decent tempo with A War Eagle, Nyman and others tracking close, creating ideal conditions for those positioned just off the pace to strike. The hold-up horses struggle to make up sufficient ground in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Milteye is allowed an easy lead with minimal early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more sedate allowing the hold-up brigade to get into contention, with late runners able to quicken effectively in the final two furlongs. Capital Guarantee and Surprised can use their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners jostle for position creating uneven fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes stop-start with tactical positioning battles, suiting versatile types who can adapt their running. Horses with tactical speed like Frostmagic can benefit from the changing tempo.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse After Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too strong and prominent runners fade dramatically
scenarios.body: The sustained early battle takes its toll on the pace-setters, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. This scenario particularly suits horses returning from breaks who may have more in reserve.

watchPoints.text: Milteye may get too easy a lead if other prominent runners are reluctant to engage early
Multiple prominent runners could create early pace pressure that sets up hold-up horses perfectly
Highfield Viking and Surprised both return from lengthy breaks but have strong form when fit
A War Eagle has been running consistently well and may benefit from the strong pace scenario
The headgear changes on Highfield Viking and Yaajooz suggest connections expect improved efforts

races.paceDynamic: Roland Garros will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting a comfortable pace without early pressure in this small field. The pace will be sustainable with six hold-up horses (Kitsune Power, Valley Of Flowers, Naval Tribute, Dr Rio, Iwantmytimewithyou) and one prominent runner (Freddy Robinson) tracking behind. The lack of pace pressure means Roland Garros can dictate terms, but the bunched field behind will produce a cavalry charge in the straight. This race shape strongly favors horses that can quicken from off the pace, particularly those with tactical speed to position well turning for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Kick Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses time their runs perfectly in the straight
scenarios.body: Roland Garros sets moderate fractions but gets swamped by late finishers with superior turn of foot. The patient tactics pay dividends as the field compresses approaching the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Roland Garros gets easy sectionals and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Roland Garros to save energy for a decisive move, opening up daylight before the closers can respond. His recent Beverley win suggests he handles the track well.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Freddy Robinson gets ideal position tracking the leader
scenarios.body: Ben Robinson positions his mount perfectly behind Roland Garros, inheriting the lead smoothly before the hold-up horses can organize their challenge. The 8-day gap keeps him sharp.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Wide Open Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses produce their effort simultaneously
scenarios.body: The sustained pace creates a blanket finish with several horses hitting the line together. Class and recent form become decisive factors in a photo finish.

watchPoints.text: Roland Garros if allowed to stride clear turning for home unchallenged - sustainable pace could see him hold late rally
Freddy Robinson's early positioning behind the leader - needs to avoid being trapped if pace quickens approaching home turn
Valley Of Flowers for market support given 216-day absence - any confidence suggests Coward team expect sharp comeback
Multiple hold-up horses converging simultaneously in straight - could create interference issues in tight finish
Apprentice Zak Wheatley's positioning on Dr Rio - inexperience could cost lengths at crucial moments despite horse's ability

runners_data.name: Man Is King
runners_data.note: Prominent racer carrying bottom weight whose recent form suggests he's found his mark at this level.

runners_data.name: Woodleigh

races.paceDynamic: Drumcondra is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings from the gate, likely setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure. No Knee Never, Copper And Five and Man Is King will settle prominently behind the leader, while the majority including Maple, Moonlight Bomb, Tees George, Woodleigh and Habari will race from midfield or further back. With limited early pace and a single leader, this creates a steady tempo that builds gradually into the straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and forward hold-up horses who can position close enough to strike, rather than pure hold-up types who may find themselves too far back when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Drumcondra controls throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Drumcondra maintains his gallop and the pace stays honest without fierce pressure
scenarios.body: The leader gets an uncontested lead and kicks for home with the prominent runners struggling to reel him in. Forward positioning becomes crucial as the pace was never strong enough to set up a cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent surge prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent trio apply pressure to Drumcondra turning for home
scenarios.body: No Knee Never, Copper And Five and Man Is King converge on the leader in the straight with their superior tactical speed telling. The modest early pace allows these handy types to finish strongest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horse charges late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway as the prominent runners engage
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and allows a classy hold-up performer like Moonlight Bomb or Tees George to unleash a telling late run. The honest gallop sets up perfectly for their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from the back
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the home turn where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of position. Longshots like Woodleigh or the returning Habari could capitalise on the tactical nature.

watchPoints.text: Monitor how aggressively the prominent trio of No Knee Never, Copper And Five and Man Is King track Drumcondra early, as this determines whether the leader gets an easy time.
Watch Drumcondra's inexperienced 3lb claimer Zak Wheatley for pace judgment errors that could either gift the race or throw it away.
Habari's 255-day absence combined with his tendency to fade in the finish makes him a risky proposition despite his hold-up style suiting if the pace is strong.
The hold-up contingent of Maple, Moonlight Bomb and Tees George need the race to develop into a proper test rather than a tactical affair to show their best.
Keep an eye on whether Copper And Five can utilise her 15lb weight advantage over some rivals when the business end arrives.

races.paceDynamic: Hashtagnotions will establish the early lead with minimal pressure, as he's the only prominent runner among eight hold-up horses. This creates a dream scenario for the front-runner, who can dictate fractions without being harassed through the early stages. The large pack of hold-up horses including Hostelry, Coolree, Glitter Code, and Mini Mac will bunch up behind, setting up a cavalry charge in the final three furlongs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with a strong finishing kick, as they'll get the perfect tactical setup to unleash their stamina over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Hashtagnotions sets sustainable fractions and the field remains bunched into the straight
scenarios.body: The large group of closers gets the ideal pace setup they need, with plenty of horse to aim at and room to manoeuvre in the home straight. Late-running specialists like Hostelry and Coolree can utilise their stamina over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runner steals it
scenarios.trigger: If Hashtagnotions gets very easy fractions and the hold-up brigade leave their run too late
scenarios.body: The leader builds an insurmountable advantage as the closers fail to coordinate their challenge, arriving too late to catch the winner. Hashtagnotions benefits from having no early pressure and the field playing into his hands.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Hashtagnotions goes very slowly and creates a sprint finish over the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl that turns into a dash, suiting horses with the most natural speed rather than stamina. This negates the staying test and brings pace-oriented runners like Mini Mac into contention.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early leader cracks badly
scenarios.trigger: If Hashtagnotions sets the pace too strong early or ties up dramatically in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The front-runner's collapse opens up the race for any hold-up horse that can pick up the pieces, creating a messy finish where position matters more than ability. The winner comes from the pack but in unconvincing fashion.

watchPoints.text: Hashtagnotions may get such easy fractions early that he builds an unassailable lead before the closers can organize their challenge
Glitter Code and Bantz are both returning from lengthy breaks and may need the run despite their obvious staying credentials
The large group of hold-up horses could cause traffic problems in the straight if they all come with their runs simultaneously
Mini Mac drops significantly in trip from recent longer distance runs which may catch him out tactically
Bizarre Law's quick return after just 5 days suggests connections are confident about his current wellbeing and form

races.paceDynamic: Barbury Boy offers the only confirmed front-running tendency, likely to take them along at a steady gallop without serious pressure from the field of hold-up horses and occasional prominent runners like Duchess T and Jambearee. The lack of natural pace-pressers means Barbury Boy can dictate terms and potentially steal a march, while the bulk of the field comprising hold-up performers will need to rely on tactical positioning and finishing kicks. With most runners preferring to come from off the pace, this creates a tactical dilemma where few want to make the running early. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Barbury Boy Dictates Terms
scenarios.trigger: If Barbury Boy gets an uncontested lead and sets sensible fractions
scenarios.body: He can control the race from the front while the hold-up brigade struggle for racing room in the straight. Front-runners and prominent racers avoid the inevitable scrimmaging that will hamper the backmarkers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and Barbury Boy's stamina gives way
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get their preferred strong finish with Von Dutch and Alice De Clare able to unleash telling late runs. Recent form runners like Smoker Bellamy can capitalize on superior fitness.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If Duchess T or Jambearee decide to press Barbury Boy early
scenarios.body: The pace quickens sufficiently to set up a genuine staying test where stamina becomes crucial. Hold-up horses with proven distance credentials can mount sustained challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites encounter traffic problems or pace issues
scenarios.body: An unfancied runner like Lynxman or Laser Luck capitalizes on a clear passage and upset odds. Mike Sowersby's pair could outrun their ratings with better recent form.

watchPoints.text: Barbury Boy must be monitored for early pace - if he goes too fast early he'll compromise his stamina reserves
Traffic problems will be severe with 12 hold-up horses converging in the straight - draw and positioning crucial
Von Dutch returning from 92-day break needs watching for fitness after encouraging pre-layoff form
Jambearee and Dream Of Ithaca both show fade-in-finish tendencies that could worsen over this staying trip
Mike Sowersby's 50% strike rate with Lynxman and Contemplation makes both worth monitoring for market moves
